component.title: VoiceInputButton
component.purpose: Expose one fixed-footprint microphone control whose recording, timeout, transcription, and cancellation states remain perceivable.

states.description: Capturing microphone input with visible level feedback.
Capture is recovering without changing the control footprint.
Transcription is active and can be cancelled inside the same control.
Voice input ended in an error state.
Recording approaches its timeout with an in-control progress ring.

claims.statement: Every lifecycle state exposes exactly one named voice-input control.
The transcribing state exposes cancellation through the same voice-input control.

voice-control.note: The component fixture renders exactly one button; semantic selection remains joinable when accessibility snapshots omit DOM test IDs.
